root_cause: Fragmented visual exploration between charts, tables, canvases and scenario modules; an entrepreneur cannot inspect the source and next action through one interaction pattern.
intervention: One progressive read-only insight layer in the canonical Portal V2 with keyboard/touch controls, visible-data selection, source-status disclosure and links to existing forecast, evidence and action routes.
prevention: New visual interfaces must use one interaction grammar and never infer provenance, uncertainty, causal impact or outcome without source-backed context.
